_DECIDE: eval_frac, the repeat_rate and traffic_ratio grids, and primary_setting are proposals. repeat_rate 0 = no evaluated query is served before evaluation; ORCAS gives a measured repeat rate for the text workload.
_bm25_depth: BM25 candidates added by S4/S5 = window depth (500), so the lexical nominator gets the same budget as the dense window; bm25.npy keeps 1000 columns for sensitivity runs.
_probe_budget: probe_budgets_frac is the SHARED SAMPLE size m/N, not the total. Total probe cost = |union of probe windows| + m (+ strata): 20 probe queries x 500-doc windows is already ~1% of N, so totals are ~1.25-2% here. H4 must be stated on the TOTAL (reported as total_encodings_frac). DECIDE: more probe queries = better estimate, higher cost (40 queries ~ 2% in windows alone).
_traffic_ratio: traffic_ratio 0.25 serves ~5 queries per round (~1000 over 2x100 rounds) out of a ~3.5k-query traffic pool: low traffic is the scenario being modelled, not a defect.
